decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is a peripheral consumer product with only a brief website mention and no evidence that it meets aspirations, so a small engineering-focused venture firm with limited slack may well cut it, though its low carrying cost argues for keeping it one more year.

The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer and share its engineering resources, so they cost little to carry and give no shortfall signal that would trigger search for alternatives.

As a flagship with its own page in a growing, R&D-intensive industry, the waste oil to energy plant is central to the firm's direction, and the firm is hiring, which suggests enough slack to carry it while results are still uncertain.

The plastic waste to fuel plant is presented as a flagship close to the core offer, and long development cycles mean management will tolerate uncertain early results rather than conclude it falls short of aspiration this early.
